execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"
CREATE TYPE "public"."EditAction" AS ENUM ('CREATE', 'UPDATE', 'CLAIM', 'DELETE')
CREATE TYPE "public"."EditFormPreference" AS ENUM ('FULL', 'COMPACT')
CREATE TYPE "public"."EditStatus" AS ENUM ('PENDING_VERIFICATION', 'VERIFIED', 'AUTO_APPROVED', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'WITHDRAWN')
CREATE TYPE "public"."Language" AS ENUM ('fi', 'en', 'sv', 'OTHER')
CREATE TYPE "public"."LarpLinkType" AS ENUM ('HOMEPAGE', 'PHOTOS', 'SOCIAL_MEDIA', 'PLAYER_GUIDE', 'OTHER', 'SIGNUP')
CREATE TYPE "public"."LarpType" AS ENUM ('ONE_SHOT', 'CAMPAIGN_LARP', 'CAMPAIGN', 'MULTIPLE_RUNS', 'OTHER_EVENT_SERIES', 'OTHER_EVENT')
CREATE TYPE "public"."LocalSignupStatus" AS ENUM ('DISABLED', 'PUBLIC', 'CODE_REQUIRED')
CREATE TYPE "public"."Openness" AS ENUM ('OPEN', 'TARGETED', 'INVITE_ONLY')
CREATE TYPE "public"."RelatedLarpType" AS ENUM ('SEQUEL', 'SPINOFF', 'IN_CAMPAIGN', 'IN_SERIES', 'RUN_OF', 'RERUN_OF', 'PLAYED_AT')
CREATE TYPE "public"."RelatedUserRole" AS ENUM ('EDITOR', 'CREATED_BY', 'GAME_MASTER', 'VOLUNTEER', 'PLAYER', 'FAVORITE', 'TEAM_MEMBER', 'LOCAL_SIGNUP_YES', 'LOCAL_SIGNUP_MAYBE', 'LOCAL_SIGNUP_NO')
CREATE TYPE "public"."RelatedUserVisibility" AS ENUM ('PARTICIPANTS', 'GM', 'ONLY_ME')
CREATE TYPE "public"."SubmitterRole" AS ENUM ('NONE', 'GAME_MASTER', 'VOLUNTEER', 'PLAYER', 'TEAM_MEMBER')
CREATE TYPE "public"."TokenType" AS ENUM ('EMAIL_VERIFICATION', 'ACCOUNT_REMOVAL')
CREATE TYPE "public"."UserRole" AS ENUM ('NOT_VERIFIED', 'VERIFIED', 'MODERATOR', 'ADMIN')

CREATE TABLE "public"."account" (
  "access_token" text,
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" int4,
  "id_token" text,
  "provider" text NOT NULL,
  "provider_account_id" text NOT NULL,
  "refresh_token" text,
  "scope" text,
  "session_state" text,
  "token_type" text,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("provider", "provider_account_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."authenticator" (
  "counter" int4 NOT NULL,
  "credential_backed_up" bool NOT NULL,
  "credential_device_type" text NOT NULL,
  "credential_id" text NOT NULL,
  "credential_public_key" text NOT NULL,
  "provider_account_id" text NOT NULL,
  "transports" text,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "credential_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."country" (
  "code" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name_en" text,
  "name_fi" text,
  "name_sv" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."holiday" (
  "date" date NOT NULL,
  "title_en" text NOT NULL,
  "title_fi" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("date")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."larp" (
  "alias" text,
  "cancelled_at" timestamp(3),
  "description" text,
  "ends_at" timestamp(3),
  "fluff_text" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "language" "Language" NOT NULL,
  "local_signup_code" text,
  "local_signup_status" "LocalSignupStatus" DEFAULT 'DISABLED'::"LocalSignupStatus" NOT NULL,
  "location_text" text,
  "municipality_id" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "num_player_characters" int4,
  "num_total_participants" int4,
  "openness" "Openness",
  "related_user_visibility" "RelatedUserVisibility" DEFAULT 'GM'::"RelatedUserVisibility" NOT NULL,
  "signup_ends_at" timestamp(3),
  "signup_starts_at" timestamp(3),
  "starts_at" timestamp(3),
  "tagline" text,
  "type" "LarpType" DEFAULT 'ONE_SHOT'::"LarpType" NOT NULL,
  "update_count" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."larp_link" (
  "href" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "larp_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "title" text,
  "type" "LarpLinkType" DEFAULT 'HOMEPAGE'::"LarpLinkType" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."moderation_request" (
  "action" "EditAction" NOT NULL,
  "add_links" jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb NOT NULL,
  "add_related_larps" jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "larp_id" uuid,
  "message" text,
  "new_content" jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL,
  "remove_links" jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb NOT NULL,
  "remove_related_larps" jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb NOT NULL,
  "resolved_at" timestamp(3),
  "resolved_by_id" uuid,
  "resolved_message" text,
  "status" "EditStatus" NOT NULL,
  "submitter_email" text NOT NULL,
  "submitter_id" uuid,
  "submitter_name" text NOT NULL,
  "submitter_role" "SubmitterRole" DEFAULT 'NONE'::"SubmitterRole" NOT NULL,
  "verification_code" uuid,
  "verified_at" timestamp(3),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."municipality" (
  "country_code" text DEFAULT 'wd:Q33' NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lat" float8 NOT NULL,
  "long" float8 NOT NULL,
  "name_fi" text,
  "name_other" text,
  "name_other_language_code" text,
  "name_sv" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."page" (
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "language" text NOT NULL,
  "slug" text DEFAULT 'front-page' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("slug", "language")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."related_larp" (
  "left_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "right_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "type" "RelatedLarpType" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("left_id", "right_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."related_user" (
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "larp_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "role" "RelatedUserRole" NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "visibility" "RelatedUserVisibility" DEFAULT 'ONLY_ME'::"RelatedUserVisibility" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("larp_id", "user_id", "role")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."session" (
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expires" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "session_token" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."unauthenticated_signup" (
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "display_name" text NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "larp_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "signup_status" "RelatedUserRole" NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "verification_code" text NOT NULL,
  "verified_at" timestamp(3),
  "visibility" "RelatedUserVisibility" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "unauthenticated_signup_signup_status_check" CHECK ((signup_status = ANY (ARRAY['LOCAL_SIGNUP_YES'::"RelatedUserRole", 'LOCAL_SIGNUP_MAYBE'::"RelatedUserRole", 'LOCAL_SIGNUP_NO'::"RelatedUserRole"]))),
  CONSTRAINT "unauthenticated_signup_visibility_check" CHECK ((visibility = ANY (ARRAY['PARTICIPANTS'::"RelatedUserVisibility", 'GM'::"RelatedUserVisibility"])))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "edit_form_preference" "EditFormPreference" DEFAULT 'FULL'::"EditFormPreference" NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "email_verified" timestamp(3),
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "image" text,
  "name" text,
  "role" "UserRole" DEFAULT 'NOT_VERIFIED'::"UserRole" NOT NULL,
  "title_en" text,
  "title_fi" text,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."verification_token" (
  "expires" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "identifier" text NOT NULL,
  "token" text NOT NULL,
  "type" "TokenType" DEFAULT 'EMAIL_VERIFICATION'::"TokenType" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("identifier", "token")
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "authenticator_credential_id_key" ON "public"."authenticator" ("credential_id")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "country_code_key" ON "public"."country" ("code")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "larp_alias_key" ON "public"."larp" ("alias")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "moderation_request_verification_code_key" ON "public"."moderation_request" ("verification_code")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "session_session_token_key" ON "public"."session" ("session_token")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "unauthenticated_signup_larp_email_pending_uidx" ON "public"."unauthenticated_signup" ("larp_id", "email") WHERE ((verified_at IS NULL))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "unauthenticated_signup_larp_email_verified_uidx" ON "public"."unauthenticated_signup" ("larp_id", "email") WHERE ((verified_at IS NOT NULL))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "unauthenticated_signup_verification_code_key" ON "public"."unauthenticated_signup" ("verification_code")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "user_email_key" ON "public"."user" ("email")
